rv.q: “The Family Album” blends those two ideas in a creative, emotionally resonant, and frequently funny world premiere musical that tackles the raw, transformative journey of healing intergenerational trauma.
The Family Album is a creative, great new musical that is true to life and frequently moving.
The music is very enjoyable, sparking conversation and reflection.

cn.t: Critics praise this world premiere musical for finding universal truth in its specific, emotionally honest story of a singer-songwriter navigating family and artistry, with strong performances elevating the material.
